visualCharacteristics.purpose: in-page sub-section laid out as side-by-side columns: headed copy and bullet lists (What You Get / How It Works), a badge or photo beside copy, a centred CTA row, or centred icon columns

contentPattern.structure: one or more rows; each cell in a row is a column. A picture-only cell is a media column; any other cell is a text column (heading, text, lists, links), and a leading picture or icon paragraph in it is the column icon. A cell holding only a link to a /fragments/ page is replaced by that fragment. Colour comes from the section style (dark, blue), not from the block

usage: Use for in-page sub-sections split into columns. Default: equal text columns with headings and bullet lists. media-feature: a badge or photo next to heading and copy, centred. dark-promo: copy next to a rounded photo (put it in a dark section). light: a centred row of CTA buttons and links. light-2: centred icon columns with heading and text.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for columned explanatory content inside a page. Use columns for generic layouts without these presets and cards for repeated clickable tiles.
